resteasy_liberty_common_patterns.overview: Common code patterns and templates for RESTeasy, Open Liberty, Jakarta EE, and MicroProfile development. These patterns represent proven solutions to recurring problems in enterprise Java applications.

pattern.name: bundle_activator_with_service_tracker
pattern.description: Track OSGi services dynamically with proper lifecycle management
pattern.use_case: When you need to react to services appearing and disappearing at runtime

pattern.name: declarative_services_component
pattern.description: Use OSGi Declarative Services for cleaner service management
pattern.use_case: Preferred approach for most OSGi service implementations

pattern.name: osgi_service_filter
pattern.description: Filter OSGi services based on properties
pattern.use_case: When you need specific service implementations based on properties

pattern.name: cdi_extension_for_custom_injection
pattern.description: Create custom CDI extension for specialized injection
pattern.use_case: When you need to inject non-CDI objects or add custom validation

pattern.name: cdi_producer_with_qualifier
pattern.description: Use qualifiers to distinguish between multiple implementations
pattern.use_case: When you have multiple implementations of the same interface

pattern.name: cdi_event_observer
pattern.description: Use CDI events for loose coupling between components
pattern.use_case: When components need to react to events without direct dependencies

pattern.name: cdi_interceptor
pattern.description: Create custom interceptors for cross-cutting concerns
pattern.use_case: For logging, security, transaction management, etc.

pattern.name: jaxrs_application_configuration
pattern.description: Configure JAX-RS application with custom providers
pattern.use_case: Setting up JAX-RS application with filters, interceptors, and providers

pattern.name: jaxrs_filter_chain
pattern.description: Implement filter chain for authentication and authorization
pattern.use_case: Securing REST endpoints with authentication and authorization

pattern.name: jaxrs_exception_hierarchy
pattern.description: Comprehensive exception mapping for REST APIs
pattern.use_case: Consistent error responses across the API

pattern.name: jaxrs_async_processing
pattern.description: Implement async REST endpoints with proper timeout handling
pattern.use_case: Long-running operations that shouldn't block request threads

pattern.name: microprofile_config_with_converter
pattern.description: Custom config converter for complex types
pattern.use_case: When you need to inject complex configuration objects

pattern.name: microprofile_health_checks
microprofile_metrics_custom
pattern.description: Custom metrics with tags and metadata

pattern.name: microprofile_fault_tolerance
pattern.description: Comprehensive fault tolerance with fallback and circuit breaker
pattern.use_case: Resilient service calls with automatic recovery

pattern.name: resteasy_cdi_integration
pattern.description: Integrate RESTeasy with CDI for dependency injection in JAX-RS resources
pattern.use_case: Standard pattern for RESTeasy applications in Liberty

pattern.name: liberty_feature_integration
pattern.description: Integrate custom feature with Liberty's feature manager
pattern.use_case: Creating Liberty features that depend on other features

pattern.name: arquillian_integration_test
pattern.description: Integration testing with Arquillian and Liberty
pattern.use_case: Testing CDI, JAX-RS, and other Jakarta EE components
